greeting.speaker: Wanderer
greeting.text: A fellow traveller. I did not expect to find anyone else out here. The fog hides more than it shows.

place.speaker: Wanderer
place.text: A basin of no name that I know of. I have walked much of it. The ground rolls, the rocks sit, and a single spire rises far off through the mist. A good place for thinking.

spire.speaker: Wanderer
spire.text: Straight ahead — if the fog thins you'll see it. It's the only thing in this basin taller than the mist. I would not try climbing it; the wind has teeth up there.

pool.speaker: Wanderer
pool.text: Strange water. It does not ripple, and its colour does not match the sky. I would not drink from it. But I have watched folk walk into it... and return changed. Walk carefully.

changed.speaker: Wanderer
changed.text: As if they had seen something the rest of us have not. They do not speak of it. I have not stepped in myself — not yet. The world is wide enough on this side of the water.

farewell.speaker: Wanderer
farewell.text: May your boots stay dry and your path stay clear. The mist looks different every hour — do not lose your way.
